runtimeEvidence.interpretation: Fail-closed behavior was correct. The candidate exposed that Phase 0 mappedItemCount classified dormant slot metadata rather than defining formal Catalog membership.

The candidate transaction rolled back completely. Diagnosis proved that database row ordering was incorrectly identity-sensitive and that 11 ordinary Ascendant rows had not inherited the accepted observed ExactItemInstance eligibility evidence.

The candidate built and individually verified the full expected membership, then rolled back because store semantics still compared SQL-returned arrays by position. Stable-key comparison now preserves strict row hashes and full Catalog identity while treating member order as non-semantic.

Build, append-only seal, exact read-back and pointer fence passed. Shadow used mode=initial, which is an intentionally empty template preview; a production probe confirmed the full mage/arcane catalog returned 199 items and 730 variants.

The candidate was actively terminated when repeated full-spec payloads accumulated in the process LRU above the accepted ceiling. The sealed Catalog remained unchanged and public services stayed active with zero restarts.

Per-spec LRU eviction reduced accumulation but full public payload deep-copy still touched the hard ceiling and used swap. The candidate was terminated; the final design reuses a single snapshot and PG selector indexes instead.

One-snapshot projection passed resource, deterministic seal and pointer gates. It incorrectly projected ExactItemInstance rows alongside canonical Browse rows; strict rowFamily=browse filtering is now covered by RED/GREEN tests.

Browse-only projection removed ExactItemInstance contamination. Diagnosis proved every remaining difference was a compact crafted synthetic key for an already-collapsed Catalog progression; deterministic aliases are now tested without restoring crafted stat choices to identity.

The raw report mapped every legacy alias, but promotion audit found item-level direct crafted-selection keys duplicated identities already present in variants lists. The candidate was not promoted; fallback-only direct keys and an explicit cardinality gate are now tested.

risks.detail: Builder removes governed crafted secondary selections, requires all remaining invariant facts to agree, and blocks conflicts.
Catalog membership seeds are hashed before Catalog-bound BrowseVariant keys are derived; verification independently rejects a mismatched derived key without changing Catalog identity.
Production candidate, exact load, immutability and API smoke all retained the active generation-32 pointer and manifest revision.
Formal ItemDefinition membership requires canonical BrowseVariant or verified ExactItemInstance usage plus governed source evidence; raw historical and source-only rows are excluded and counted.
Catalog identity canonicalizes member order, while verified item-level-298 exact evidence is applied to ordinary Ascendant Track Authority before BrowseVariant construction.
The 40-specialization verifier explicitly requests the complete compact catalog payload; initial template preview mode is excluded from parity evidence.
The final shadow reads one active snapshot, builds PG selector indexes once, emits only per-spec visible identity pairs, and runs under the accepted memory and elapsed hard ceilings.
